description.en: Removes a party member silently (no message/jingle) via RemovePartyCmnd, automatically locking the vacated position slot when the status is not being reset (and vice versa).
Param ID of the character to remove from the party.
Whether to reset the member's status; also determines the (inverted) position-lock flag passed to RemovePartyCmnd.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove a party member silently, without a message or jingle
RemoveParty("para_cp0009", false);
